t: How the Duplicate Cluster Manager works (Signature)
title: How the Duplicate Cluster Manager works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Duplicate Cluster Manager does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach runs blocking and fuzzy matching with frozen thresholds and a frozen field-weight table, so the same dataset always yields the same clusters. Each cluster carries its pairwise match ledger — which pairs matched, at what similarity, under which block — making every proposal auditable. Review decisions (merge, keep-both, split) append to a decision ledger that is never rewritten. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
